parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
Enterprising people have many attributes, characteristics and learned skills. These include:
• determination to succeed
• practical skills
• problem-solving
• taking the initiative.
Discuss how Emma used any two of these skills in the organisation of her ideas.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
If Luca and Emma organise either tennis lessons or the film club, they will need to produce
marketing communications. The methods they choose will need to be appropriate to inform
existing members and attract new members to the youth centre.
Possible methods could include:
• local cinema advertisements
• posters
• social media
• sponsorship of a sports team.
Evaluate which two of these methods would be most appropriate for the youth centre charity.
Justify your choice.

Now consider your enterprise project.

Enterprises have different objectives, each of which will affect how the enterprise operates.
These include:
• having a positive cash flow
• achieving growth
• maximising sales revenue
• ensuring survival.
Analyse how two objectives affected, or could have affected, the operation of your enterprise
project.
